title: 13 Best Herbal Creams For Strep Throat
intro: Herbal creams for Strep throat are topical preparations made from plant extracts and essential oils that help to soothe and heal the affected areas of the throat. These creams offer several benefits in treating Strep throat, including reducing inflammation, pain, and discomfort, as well as promoting faster healing and recovery. Examples of herbal creams used to treat Strep throat include Echinacea cream, which contains anti-inflammatory properties, Sage cream, which has antibacterial and antiviral properties, and Slippery Elm cream, which soothes and protects the mucous membranes of the throat. Additionally, other herbal creams such as Licorice root, Marshmallow root, and Tea tree oil cream are also used to treat Strep throat due to their antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties.

preparations.preparation_desc: Echinacea purpurea creams have been used to treat strep throat by leveraging their anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help to soothe the throat and reduce the severity of symptoms. The bioactive constituents present in Echinacea purpurea creams, such as alkylamides and glycosides, have been shown to possess immunomodulatory effects that aid in the treatment of strep throat by boosting the immune system's response to the infection. These creams work by reducing the inflammation and swelling in the throat, making it easier to swallow and breathe, and by inhibiting the growth of the streptococcal bacteria that causes the infection. The use of Echinacea purpurea creams to treat strep throat has been associated with several benefits, including reduced symptoms, faster recovery times, and minimal side effects, making it a popular alternative to conventional treatments.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Molecules (Basel, Switzerland)", Echinacea purpurea creams for strep throat may be beneficial as the ethanol extract of the purple coneflower flower (Echinacea purpurea) was found to be one of the most effective against Streptococcus pyogenes in the study, inhibiting bacterial growth and biofilm formation.

preparations.preparation_desc: Glycyrrhiza glabra creams, derived from the roots of the licorice plant, have been traditionally used to treat strep throat due to their anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The saponins and flavonoids present in these creams help to reduce throat inflammation, combat bacterial infections, and soothe the mucous membranes, thereby alleviating the symptoms of strep throat. The bioactive constituents of Glycyrrhiza glabra creams, including glycyrrhizin and licochalcone A, have been shown to exhibit potent antimicrobial activity, inhibiting the growth of Streptococcus pyogenes, the primary cause of strep throat. By using Glycyrrhiza glabra creams, individuals can experience relief from strep throat symptoms, including pain, swelling, and difficulty swallowing, making it a valuable natural remedy for this common ailment.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Journal of the Medical Association of Thailand = Chotmaihet thangphaet", Glycyrrhiza glabra creams may be an effective option for treating strep throat due to its strong antimicrobial activity, particularly against S. pyogenes, with MIC and MBC values at 39 and 78 μg/ml, respectively.

The bioactive constituents, including eucalyptol, eugenol, and tannins, help to combat bacterial infections and reduce inflammation in the throat, thereby alleviating symptoms of strep throat. By applying Eucalyptus globulus creams topically, the soothing properties of eucalyptus oil can help to calm irritated mucous membranes and reduce pain, making it easier to swallow and breathe. The benefits of using Eucalyptus globulus creams to treat strep throat include reduced discomfort, improved healing, and a quicker recovery, making it a popular natural remedy among those seeking alternative treatments.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Evidence-based complementary and alternative medicine : eCAM", Eucalyptus globulus creams for strep throat may be beneficial based on traditional medicinal practices in Ethiopia, where Eucalyptus globulus was found to be one of the top-cited plant species used in the treatment of respiratory diseases, including cough, which is a common symptom of strep throat.

By reducing swelling and fighting off the bacteria, Zingiber officinale creams help to alleviate the pain and discomfort associated with strep throat, allowing for a more comfortable recovery.
